summary: Timed wakeup attribution under idle, user, system-call and mixed load on four CPUs

cases.behavior: 64 timed waits of 5 ms through each of six interfaces finish beside pinned idle load; print lateness and per-thread timer, run-queue and lock accounting without a host-dependent time verdict

execution.cleanup: stop and join every worker, unmap each worker mapping, close the timerfd and epoll set and free the samples on every exit

assertions.checks: Every worker binds to its CPU and completes one unit before the measured waits start

Each of the 64 waits returns its expected timeout or timerfd count, every recorded timed wake has each big-lock subset no greater than its enclosing stage, and where the kernel keeps the records at least one wait is recorded
